name: Sugawa Mari
source:
"..."

A girl who commits suicide no matter how many times she tries again.

The causes vary from time to time: sometimes she died as a student while other times she died as a result of society.

Even so, Kami always rewinds her life before she can truly die.

[Translated from [url=http://dswtc.web.fc2.com/game/jinseikanojo/jinseikanojo.html]official website[/url]]
